stage: exclusion_baselines — B1-direct and SFT-V1 on the composition-exclusion split
prereg: prereg.md, committed before any number was inspected

eval.set: 210-structure composition-exclusion (every structure has a train-unseen element)
eval.protocol: 3-sample majority vote, temp 0.7, 512 max new tokens — identical to the E3 matrix arms

B1_direct.note: emits a bare crystal-system label, no chain to score

comparisons_vs_pooled_noise.convention: pooled = sqrt((s1^2+s2^2)/2) — program-wide, see ledger/CONVENTIONS.md (was quadrature-sum here before unification)
comparisons_vs_pooled_noise.note: unifying the convention changed no verdict; the adopted form gives smaller (less conservative) thresholds

SFT_V1.reading: FROZEN at 3 seeds (the freeze rule earned its keep — the direction FLIPPED between seed 1 and seed 2). process-verified GRPO improved on its SFT initialization (+0.040 V2a, +0.049 V2b, both exceeding pooled seed noise); outcome-only GRPO did not measurably (+0.008 vs pooled 0.046). Per the directive this must be confirmed with PAIRED PER-STRUCTURE stats before the sentence is frozen for the paper — seed means alone are used here.

decision_rule.a: B1 >= ~0.60 -> accuracy story dead, E3 scale-up deprioritized
decision_rule.b: B1 <= ~0.40 -> memorize/generalize headline, E3 scale-up justified
decision_rule.intermediate: 0.40 < B1 < 0.60 -> report partial, do not force a branch

BRANCH_TAKEN: (a) — observed mean 0.614 >= 0.60. THE ACCURACY STORY IS DEAD. E3 scale-up DEPRIORITIZED.

robustness.verdict: branch (a) does not depend on the 0.60 boundary — even the worst B1 seed beats the best chain arm by +0.181

hypothesis.predicted: B1 degrades substantially OOD while GRPO chain arms retain more (per Chu et al. arXiv 2501.17161)
hypothesis.outcome: REFUTED — B1 lost only 13.6% relative and leads every GRPO arm by +0.23 to +0.27
candidate_reasons_untested: composition-exclusion withholds ELEMENTS, not the lattice geometry the task depends on — likely IID in the decisive feature
our GRPO arms ran 300 steps from a weak SFT ckpt and never beat it on accuracy, so this is not the comparison 2501.17161's claim addresses
B1's 4-8 token label target is the easiest thing to fit and least sensitive to nuisance shift

budget_accounting.measured_from: live Qwen3-VL processor at max_pixels=200704, NOT formula-derived

accounting_3_wall_clock_measured.cause: SFT-V1 reaches [ANSWER] 1.1% of the time so every generation runs to the 512-token cap

budget_accounting.note: under accounting (1) B1 uses 67x LESS compute and still wins, which strengthens branch (a)

secondary_finding.claim: 2501.17161's format-stabilisation half REPRODUCES even though its generalization half does not
secondary_finding.evidence: SFT-V1 reached [ANSWER] 1.1%; post-GRPO arms reach ~65-85% (B3 10/12, V2a 8/12, V2b 10/12)

consequences: E3 scale-up DEPRIORITIZED (branch (a) withdraws the accuracy justification)
the paper's claim must be verifiability / faithfulness / test-time scaling, not accuracy
defensible headline: a direct image->label mapping is accuracy-optimal here; the verified chain's value is that it is CHECKABLE
